headline: Army Reserve Captain · Operations, Logistics & Program Management
summary: Army Reserve Captain and City of Leavenworth Recreation Supervisor focused on planning and operations: multi-year mission planning, training exercises, logistics, community events and programs, budgets, and staff leadership.

experience.title: Team XO, Observer Coach/Trainer (OC/T), Captain
experience.company: 2-383rd Training Support Battalion, U.S. Army Reserve
highlights: Serve as second-in-command of an OC/T team that coaches, trains, and evaluates Army Reserve units during collective training; have evaluated 5 teams.
Coordinate team personnel, logistics, scheduling, and administrative requirements to execute exercises.
Lead After Action Reviews with unit leaders, measuring performance against Army doctrine and standards.
Coach company-level leaders on mission planning, troop leading procedures, and sustainment operations.

experience.title: Recreation Supervisor
highlights: Planned, marketed, and ran 15 community events a year, including Touch-A-Truck, the Easter Festival and Egg Hunt, Daddy and Me Sweetheart Tea, Superhero Dance, Family and Adult (21+) Dive-In Movies, Doggie Splash, Trunk or Treat (now Haunted Depot), the Mayor’s Holiday Lighted Parade and Tree Lighting, and Breakfast with Santa.
Managed at least one, and often several, ongoing contractor agreements for nearly every special event.
Coordinated 45 vendors at each of the summer and November holiday flea markets.
Oversaw the recreation and fitness class schedule, including Toddler Time, three Aquacise classes, Water Walking, PiYo, Karate, Dance, Harp, and Dog Obedience.
Marketed every event and class: monthly emails to 1,600 subscribers, flyers designed and distributed in person, RecDesk registration, and public relations.
Monitored revenues and expenditures, processed invoices, and reconciled weekly P-card purchases in Munis for myself and a full-time staff member.
Supervised 1 full-time employee and 62 part-time seasonal staff, from recruiting and training to scheduling and evaluations.

experience.title: Company Commander, Captain
highlights: Planned and executed missions across current and future fiscal years, up to three years out.
Led 79 soldiers in four platoons responsible for transporting and distributing 1.5 million gallons of fuel.
Maintained accountability for $20 million in unit equipment.
Directed 6 full-time staff across personnel, training, operations, maintenance, and supply.

experience.title: Executive Officer, First Lieutenant
highlights: Managed administration, maintenance, logistics, supply, and personnel for 79 soldiers and 103 vehicles.
Synchronized the work of 6 full-time staff across personnel, training, operations, maintenance, and supply.
Advised the Company Commander on training, readiness, and daily operations.

experience.title: Aquatic Manager
highlights: Managed 62 part-time seasonal staff across lifeguard, head lifeguard, assistant manager, security, and cashier roles; recruited, trained, and hired most of them.
Oversaw the City’s Red Cross Learn-to-Swim program, serving an estimated 200+ children: 64 swim lessons each summer and more than 25 each fall, winter, and spring.
Taught 2 to 3 American Red Cross Lifeguarding courses a year, plus Water Safety Instructor courses.
Built weekly staff schedules and conducted staff performance reviews.
Coordinated yearly sexual harassment training with HR, and a yearly active shooter drill with the Police Department, for all aquatic personnel.

experience.title: Assistant Aquatic Manager
highlights: Served as acting Aquatic Manager for 2 months in 2018.
Earlier City roles: Head Lifeguard (2015–2017) and Lifeguard (2013–2015).

education.credential: Bachelor of General Studies, Organizational Communications (minor in Business)

honors.name: Eagle Scout
honors.detail: Planned and led 15 volunteers in a 10-hour project repainting the City of Leavenworth skate park.
